gaps: The vocabulary has no operation or named request path for saving weight parameters, so the two-weight arrangement and the subsequent save with only qa_freight_adj cannot be performed.
read_round does not expose a weight-list or row-status read-back field, so qa_freight_adj, weighted_total, and qa_quality_pen cannot be verified.
